critiques_addressed.critique: Unresolved clamping gap in SVD truncation (Yuan Cheng, Joseph S. Chang)
critiques_addressed.resolution: Strengthened Proposition 1 proves clamping REDUCES L1 error via index-wise argument (Lemma 2). Bound is ε_trunc, NOT 2ε_trunc. Numerical verification via verify_clamping_reduces_error(). 54+ tests confirm.

critiques_addressed.critique: Only N<=2 species tested (Yuan Cheng, Lila Zhang)
critiques_addressed.resolution: Scaling experiments up to N=10 species. 13 biological models. Multi-species CSL checking on N=3 cascade.

critiques_addressed.critique: No independent certificate verification (Joseph S. Chang, Lila Zhang)
critiques_addressed.resolution: CertificateVerifier with 11 soundness checks. JSON-serializable traces for external auditing.

critiques_addressed.critique: Fragile fixpoint iteration for slowly-mixing CTMCs (Aniruddha Sinha)
critiques_addressed.resolution: Spectral-gap-informed convergence prediction with Rayleigh quotient refinement and adaptive bounded-until fallback.

critiques_addressed.critique: Non-axis-aligned predicates have exponential TT rank (Lila Zhang)
critiques_addressed.resolution: Theorem 3: linear predicates have TT-rank at most R+1 via carry-based construction. General predicates remain exponential — documented as fundamental limitation.
